_comment: A fixed, deterministic set of test-split images for depth export parity (Lesson 04, step 6, Round 3). Deliberately NOT the same set as export_parity_images.json: export_depth()'s probe image is sorted(test/images)[0], and its int8 calibration set is the next 8 sorted siblings of that probe image — exactly the images export_parity_images.json lists. Measuring parity on calibration images would overstate fidelity. This file picks sorted(test/images)[30:38] instead, far enough past the calibration slice to stay disjoint even if the calibration count changes.
